slides.title: Five phrases to swap after a broken night
slides.body: The words you use shape the next morning.

slides.title: "I chose rest."
slides.body: Instead of "I skipped". A decision, not a lapse.

slides.title: "I started."
slides.body: Instead of "only ten minutes". A small start counts as completion.

slides.title: "It's closed."
slides.body: Instead of "I'll make it up". Planned rest leaves no debt.

slides.title: "It didn't fit today."
slides.body: Instead of "I failed the plan". The plan was made before the night.

slides.title: "What fits?"
slides.body: Instead of "I should". One question opens three options.
